<?php
error_reporting(E_ALL);
function vnw44_error($severity,$message,$file,$line){
 if(!(error_reporting()&$severity))return false;
 file_put_contents(WP_CONTENT_DIR.'/vnw44-errors.jsonl',json_encode(compact('severity','message','file','line'))."\n",FILE_APPEND|LOCK_EX);return false;
}
set_error_handler('vnw44_error');
add_filter('pre_wp_mail',function($return,$atts){update_option('vnw_test_mail',$atts);update_option('vnw_test_mail_count',(int)get_option('vnw_test_mail_count')+1);return true;},10,2);
add_action('rest_api_init',function(){
 register_rest_route('vnw-test/v1','/mail',['methods'=>'GET','permission_callback'=>'__return_true','callback'=>fn()=>get_option('vnw_test_mail')]);
 register_rest_route('vnw-test/v1','/status',['methods'=>'GET','permission_callback'=>'__return_true','callback'=>function(){
  $posts=get_posts(['post_type'=>['page','post'],'post_status'=>'publish','numberposts'=>-1,'meta_key'=>'_vnw_source']);$editable=0;$sources=[];
  foreach($posts as $p){if(vnw_elementor_enabled($p->ID))$editable++;$sources[get_post_meta($p->ID,'_vnw_source',true)]=$p->ID;}
  $log=WP_CONTENT_DIR.'/vnw44-errors.jsonl';$errors=[];
  if(file_exists($log))foreach(file($log,FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES|FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES) as $line){$e=json_decode($line,true);if($e)$errors[]=$e;}
  return ['php'=>PHP_VERSION,'wordpress'=>get_bloginfo('version'),'elementor'=>defined('ELEMENTOR_VERSION')?ELEMENTOR_VERSION:null,'theme'=>wp_get_theme()->get('Version'),'pages'=>count($posts),'editable'=>$editable,'sources'=>$sources,'errors'=>$errors,'upgrade'=>get_option('vnw44_upgrade_report'),'fresh'=>get_option('vnw44_fresh_report'),'mailCount'=>(int)get_option('vnw_test_mail_count'),'linted'=>get_option('vnw44_linted')];
 }]);
});
